description: Hardened deposits of digestive fluid that can form in your gallbladder.
causes: Too much cholesterol or bilirubin in bile, or gallbladder not emptying correctly.
symptoms: Sudden pain in the upper right abdomen
Pain in the center of the abdomen
prevention: Maintain a healthy weight, don't skip meals, and eat a high-fiber diet.
treatment_action: Surgery to remove the gallbladder or medications to dissolve stones.
complications: Inflammation of the gallbladder (cholecystitis), blockage of the bile duct, and pancreatitis.

description: A group of conditions with one thing in common: inflammation of the lining of the stomach.
causes: H. pylori infection, regular use of pain relievers, and excessive alcohol use.
symptoms: Gnawing or burning ache or pain in the upper abdomen
A feeling of fullness in the upper abdomen after eating
prevention: Avoid irritants like alcohol and NSAIDs, and practice good hygiene to avoid H. pylori.
treatment_action: Antibiotics, proton pump inhibitors, and antacids.

description: A group of eye conditions that damage the optic nerve, often due to high eye pressure.
causes: Buildup of fluid pressure in the eye.
symptoms: Patchy blind spots in peripheral vision
prevention: Regular eye exams and managing eye pressure.
treatment_action: Eye drops, laser treatment, and surgery.

description: A complex form of arthritis characterized by sudden, severe attacks of pain, swelling, redness and tenderness in the joints.
causes: High levels of uric acid in the blood.
prevention: Drink plenty of water, limit alcohol, and eat a balanced diet low in purines.
treatment_action: Medications to treat attacks and prevent future flares.
complications: Recurrent gout, advanced gout (tophi), and kidney stones.

description: A sexually transmitted infection (STI) caused by bacteria.
symptoms: Pus-like discharge from the penis or vagina
Pain or swelling in one testicle
prevention: Safe sex practices and regular STI testing.
complications: Infertility, spread to joints and other areas, and increased risk of HIV.

description: A rare disorder in which your body's immune system attacks your nerves.
causes: Often preceded by an infectious illness such as a respiratory or digestive infection.
symptoms: Weakness in legs that spreads to upper body
prevention: No known way to prevent Guillain-Barre syndrome.
complications: Breathing difficulties, residual numbness, and heart/blood pressure problems.
